==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/fɹiː ʌv t͡ʃʰɑɹd͡ʒ/|a=GA}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-free of charge.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj|-}}

# Not requiring any [[payment]].
#: {{syn|en|free<id:free of charge>|free as in beer|gratis#Adjective|feeless|costless|courtesy}}
#: {{ant|en|''see at'' [[nonfree]]}}<!--This word has no obvious, all-purpose antonym in English; antonymous translations have been placed in {{m|en|nonfree}} out of convenience.-->
#: {{cot|en|free as in speech|libre}}
#: {{ux|en|Buy two and pay for just one – the other is '''free of charge'''.}}

====Related terms====
{{col|en
|chargeback
|uncharged<id:not charged for, given away for free>
}}
